Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1120
Claimant:
Laurie Gonzales
Adjuster:
Darin Tyler
2023-04-26
Claim opened after the policyholder reported being struck while turning left at an intersection. The claimant is the
driver of the other vehicle and is represented by counsel, and all further contact is being routed through the attorney's
office.
2023-05-19
Reviewed the initial statements from both drivers and the police report. Both accounts describe the same sequence of
events, with the other vehicle entering the intersection as the policyholder completed the left turn.
2023-05-20
Obtained scene photographs and spoke with two independent witnesses, who both confirm the collision occurred as
described. Nothing in their accounts conflicts with the other driver's version.
2023-06-01
Inspected the vehicle damage. The damage is mostly consistent with the impact descriebd and lines up with the
points of contact shown in the scene photos.
2023-06-08
Verified coverage. The driving policyholder lives with the named insured and qualifies as a covered houeshold
member. Nothing suggests the damage predates the start of the policy.
2023-06-12
Requested prior claims history for the vehicle and found no earlier damage on record that would overlap with this
loss.
2023-06-24
Received the claimant's medical records through counsel. The reported knee injury fits well with the type and force of
a side impact of this kind.
2023-07-26
Reviewed the treatment history. The care followed a typical course, with frequency of visits tapering as the claimant
improved and returned to normal activity.
2023-08-13
Checked prior medical records for the same body area and found no earlier injury or complaint involving the knee.
2023-09-09
Spoke with the claimant through counsel. The account given matches what was described in every earlier
conversation, with no material differences in the details.
2023-10-19
Noted that the exact seating position of the claimant at impact is not fully clear from the available records. This is
being documented, though it does not crurently change the assessment of the injury.
2023-11-01
Current status: liability and injury evaluation are substantially complete. File is pending final review and settlement
discussions with counsel.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
JSON format:
{"findings": [{"feature": "", "rating": "", "confidence": "", "quote": "", "reason": ""}]}
